title: Olson 2006: lumbar paraspinal EMG cessation/re-initiation in standing flexion-extension (% cycle) and peak angles
condition: standing trunk flexion-extension to touch toes, 10 s cycle, no load

quantity.name: EMG off/on time and peak angles
quantity.definition: time of EMG cessation (off) in flexion and re-initiation (on) in extension as % of the flexion-extension cycle (0 = upright start, 100 = upright end); peak lumbar flexion and inclination angles (deg) and their timing

source.authors: Olson M, Solomonow M, Li L

protocol.summary: 5 cycles standing; 5 s flexion, 5 s extension.
how_to_simulate: Trunk flexion-extension with peak lumbar flexion 53 deg and inclination 112 deg at 48% of the cycle (linear tempo)
Output: cycle % (or angle mapped through the measured angle-time course) at which the model's lumbar ES activation drops below threshold and resumes
protocol.notes: Surface EMG (right side): lumbar paraspinal LP at L3-L4, 3 cm lateral to the spinous processes; RA 3 cm and EO 15 cm lateral to the umbilicus; RF, SM, BF on the thigh. On/off threshold 5% of the maximal linear envelope across all trials (10 Hz envelope), confirmed on raw EMG. Kinematics: markers on 12th rib, iliac crest, greater trochanter; lumbar flexion angle = rib-iliac line vs iliac-trochanter line; inclination = trunk vs vertical. Cycle: 5 s flexion to touch toes + 5 s extension (metronome 1 beat/s), barefoot, feet shoulder width. FR angle is not given directly (angle-time mapping only in the Fig 1 exemplar).

data.x: timing of peak lumbar flexion (% cycle)

data.note: Table 3 n=7; text says RA n=5
Table 3 n=5; text says EO n=7

extraction.check_notes: Tables 1-2 checked against page image (p.2549); the '7' in pdftotext is the +/- sign. RA/EO n differ between Table 3 (7/5) and text (5/7): flagged.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (angles); for SEM-reported data use SD = SEM x sqrt(n)
